name: UNSEEN MEN - Email & WhatsApp Styling Blueprint

parameters.jsCode:
// Prepare luxury HTML email template and formatted WhatsApp message const item = $input.first().json; const memberNum = String(item.memberNumber || '0302').padStart(4, '0'); const name = item.user?.name || 'Gentleman'; const phone = (item.user?.phone || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''); const email = item.user?.email || ''; const faceShape = item.user?.faceShape || 'Square'; const photoUrl = item.user?.photoUrl || ''; const referralCode = item.referralCode || 'UM-VIP'; const referralLink = item.referralLink || `https://unseen-men.vercel.app/?ref=${referralCode}`; const thirds = item.styling?.facialThirds || { upperPct: 29, midPct: 37, lowerPct: 34 }; const barber = item.styling?.barberGuide || { primaryDirection: 'Lift, not width', topLength: '5.5 – 7.0 cm', sidesLength: '1.0 cm (#3 guard) into skin taper', taper: 'Low-to-mid taper', stylingProduct: 'Matte texturizing clay or styling powder', notes: 'Square off the corners at the crown. Do not leave heavy bulk over the ears.' }; const cuts = item.styling?.topCuts || [ { name: 'Textured Crop with Mid Fade', why: 'Softens jaw corners while adding clean vertical height.' }, { name: 'Modern Pompadour with Low Taper', why: 'Elongates facial structure and keeps sides sleek.' }, { name: 'Classic Side Part with Taper', why: 'Highlights masculine bone structure with balanced proportion.' } ]; const optical = item.styling?.eyewear?.optical || [ { name: 'Defined D-Frame', desc: 'Softens sharp jaw corners with vertical lift.' }, { name: 'Modern Browline', desc: 'Strong top rim draws the eye upward to brow.' } ]; // 1. Clean WhatsApp Text (For WhatsApp Web Gateway or Meta Cloud API) const whatsappMessage = `*UNSEEN MEN · THE ARCHITECTURAL EDIT* 🏛️\n\n` + `Hey ${name}, your bespoke Grooming & Style Blueprint is ready!\n\n` + `👤 *Member:* #${memberNum}\n` + `📐 *Face Shape:* ${faceShape}\n` + `📊 *Proportions:* ${thirds.upperPct}% Upper / ${thirds.midPct}% Mid / ${thirds.lowerPct}% Lower\n\n` + `✂️ *YOUR TOP HAIRCUTS:*\n` + cuts.slice(0, 3).map((c, i) => `${i + 1}. *${c.name}*\n _${c.why}_`).join('\n') + `\n\n` + `💈 *BARBER SALON INSTRUCTIONS:*\n` + `• Top: ${barber.topLength}\n` + `• Sides: ${barber.sidesLength}\n` + `• Taper: ${barber.taper}\n` + `• Product: ${barber.stylingProduct}\n` + `• Note: "${barber.notes}"\n\n` + `👓 *RECOMMENDED FRAMES:*\n` + optical.slice(0, 2).map(o => `• *${o.name}*: ${o.desc}`).join('\n') + `\n\n` + `🎨 *WARDROBE BASE NEUTRALS:*\n` + `Warm Ivory, Camel, Deep Navy, Espresso, Olive\n\n` + `🔗 *View your private interactive Lookbook & referral rewards:*\n${referralLink}\n\n` + `_UNSEEN MEN Concierge · Reply anytime for 1-on-1 styling advice._`; // 2. Luxury Dark-Mode Editorial HTML Email const emailHtml = ` UNSEEN MEN · The Architectural Edit
UNSEEN MEN · THE EDIT

Bespoke Architectural Grooming Report

 Member #${memberNum}

Good day, ${name}.
Based on your facial scanning analysis, here is your curated architectural blueprint for haircuts, eyewear, beard contouring, and wardrobe palettes.

01 THE FACE · ARCHITECTURE

${faceShape} Face Shape

Facial Thirds Proportions: ${thirds.upperPct}% Upper (Forehead) · ${thirds.midPct}% Mid (Brow-Nose) · ${thirds.lowerPct}% Lower (Nose-Chin).

Direction: ${barber.primaryDirection}
02 THE HAIR · CURATED CUTS & BARBER SPECS ${cuts.slice(0, 3).map((c, i) => ` `).join('')}
${i + 1}. ${c.name}
${c.why}
Salon / Barber Specs:
• Top: ${barber.topLength}
• Sides: ${barber.sidesLength}
• Taper: ${barber.taper}
• Product: ${barber.stylingProduct}
• "${barber.notes}"
03 THE FRAMES & WARDROBE COLOR

Recommended Specs: ${optical.map(o => o.name).join(' · ')}.
Flattering Wardrobe Neutrals: Ivory, Oatmeal, Camel, Deep Navy, Dark Chocolate, Olive.

View Your Interactive Lookbook →
Your personal referral code: ${referralCode} (Invite 3 friends for launch privileges)
UNSEEN MEN · Private Grooming & Architecture · Confidential
Need direct advice? Reply to this email or reach us on WhatsApp.
`; return [{ json: { name, phone, email, memberNumber: memberNum, faceShape, referralCode, referralLink, whatsappMessage, emailHtml, emailSubject: `UNSEEN MEN · Your Architectural Grooming Edit (#${memberNum})` } }];
